characters.continuity: Sonic the Hedgehog series (Main Canon / Sega games)
characters.summary: Sonic the Hedgehog uses his superhuman speed and agility to overwhelm opponents with high-speed physical strikes, the Homing Attack, and the Spin Dash. He relies on mobility, reflexes, and environmental momentum to dodge attacks and defeat enemies.

mechanisms: Invincibility through Chaos Emeralds (temporarily as Super Sonic)

weaknesses: Vulnerable when caught off-guard or stripped of speed momentum
limitations: Speed requires traction and momentum to reach maximum capacity

sources.supports: Basic summary, abilities, and characteristics of Sonic the Hedgehog.
Specific techniques like Homing Attack and Spin Dash.

feats.claim: Defeated Dr. Eggman's numerous mechs and robots using the Homing Attack and Spin Dash.
feats.citation: Sonic the Hedgehog (1991) and subsequent main titles

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill aboard the Ark before teaming up.

campaignTags.claim: Sonic can fly briefly or maintain high-speed aerial movement in certain states, though primarily relies on running.

unknowns: Exact top speed limits vary across different media and game engines.

characters.summary: Darkspine Sonic channels intense fury and three World Rings, granting him pyrokinesis, immense physical strength, and flight. He fights with brutal, fiery melee attacks rather than his standard playful demeanor.
weaknesses: Short duration driven by emotional intensity and anger
limitations: Form is temporary and tied to specific emotional catalysts and World Rings
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Sonic into a dark-skinned, winged entity engulfed in blue and violet flames, utilizing fire attacks and extreme aggression.

sources.supports: Darkspine Sonic form, abilities, and appearance in Sonic and the Secret Rings.

feats.claim: Defeated Erazor Djinn in his Alf Layla wa Layla form.

conditional.dependsOn: World Rings of Rage, Hatred, and Sadness

campaignTags.claim: Controls and generates fire using the power of the World Rings of Rage and Hatred.
Capable of sustained flight in the Darkspine form.

unknowns: Whether this form can be accessed outside of the Arabian Nights book world.

characters.summary: Excalibur Sonic is clad in legendary golden armor and wields the sacred sword Excalibur. He engages enemies with devastating swordplay, high-speed aerial charges, and impenetrable armor defense.
weaknesses: Relies on the magical power of the sacred swords
limitations: Form is tied to the magical resonance of the sacred swords
characters.formDifferences: Equips Sonic with full golden knight armor and the legendary sword Excalibur, granting flight and enhanced durability.

sources.supports: Excalibur Sonic equipment, golden armor, and abilities in Sonic and the Black Knight.

feats.claim: Defeated the Dark Queen in Sonic and the Black Knight.

notableResults.note: Freed Merlina from the scabbard's corruption.

conditional.dependsOn: Excalibur and the four sacred swords

campaignTags.claim: Excalibur Sonic can fly effortlessly in golden armor.
Wields the legendary sword Excalibur and wears its enchanted armor.

unknowns: Durability limits of the golden armor against cosmic-level threats.

characters.summary: Hyper Sonic is an evolved state achieved through the Super Emeralds, granting blinding speed, flashing chromatic afterimages, and a screen-clearing double-jump dash attack.

mechanisms: Automatic screen-clear of minor enemies upon activation

weaknesses: Requires Rings to maintain form over time
limitations: Consumes Rings continuously; reverts when rings reach zero
characters.formDifferences: Changes Sonic's color rapidly through a chromatic spectrum and adds a powerful screen-clearing flash dash.

sources.supports: Hyper Sonic transformation, abilities, and origin with Super Emeralds.

feats.claim: Traveled through the Hidden Palace and defeated Doomsday Zone bosses with enhanced Chaos power.

campaignTags.claim: Can fly freely in all directions while in Hyper form.

unknowns: Reasons for the form's absence in later modern games.

characters.summary: Sonic the Werehog relies on brutish physical strength, stretching arms, and heavy wrestling-style grappling moves rather than speed. He excels at close-quarters combat against hordes of dark monsters.

mechanisms: High physical resilience and durability against blunt force

weaknesses: Drastically reduced running speed compared to normal Sonic
limitations: Only active during nighttime or areas saturated with Dark Gaia energy
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Sonic into a large, beastly, stretchy-armed brawler with immense strength but minimal running speed.

sources.supports: Sonic the Werehog combat mechanics, stretchy arms, and attributes in Sonic Unleashed.

feats.claim: Defeated hordes of Dark Gaia minions and giant Dark Gaia Phoenix using brute strength.

notableResults.note: Defeated in combat using heavy combos.

unknowns: Permanent permanence of the curse post-Unleashed.

characters.summary: Super Sonic harnesses the power of the seven Chaos Emeralds to achieve god-like invulnerability, flight, and immense energy projection, making him capable of fighting massive cosmic deities.

mechanisms: Complete invulnerability to all conventional and magical attacks

weaknesses: Time limit dictated by Ring count
limitations: Form lasts only as long as Rings are maintained or sustained by energy sources
characters.formDifferences: Turns Sonic golden, spikes his quills upward, and grants flight and absolute invulnerability.

sources.supports: Super Sonic origins, Chaos Emerald power, and invulnerability.

feats.claim: Defeated Perfect Chaos, the Biolizard, and Solaris using Super Sonic power.
feats.citation: Sonic Adventure, Sonic Adventure 2, Sonic the Hedgehog (2006)

notableResults.note: Defeated the water god in flooded Station Square.
Fought alongside Shadow and Silver to defeat a sun god across timelines.

conditional.dependsOn: Seven Chaos Emeralds and Ring supply

campaignTags.claim: Super Sonic has total omnidirectional flight capability.

unknowns: Exact upper tier of energy output before ring depletion.

characters.summary: Sora wields the Keyblade to execute fluid melee combos, cast elemental magic, and summon Drive Forms or Keyblade transformations. He combines acrobatic mobility with versatile spellcasting to handle varied threats.
weaknesses: Vulnerable when MP is recharging after casting spells
limitations: MP recharge period after depleting magic meter

sources.supports: Sora overview, Keyblade usage, and magical abilities.
Specific spells, Drive Forms, and combat mechanics.

feats.claim: Sealed Keyholes across multiple worlds and defeated Xehanort's incarnations.

notableResults.note: Defeated Riku when possessed by Ansem.
Defeated Xehanort with Keyblade wielders' assistance.

campaignTags.claim: Sora casts a wide variety of offensive and defensive spells (Fire, Blizzard, Thunder, Cure).
Proficient in casting magic spells via MP consumption.
Can glide and fly in certain worlds and Drive forms.

unknowns: Full extent of powers without the Keyblade.

characters.continuity: Spyro the Dragon series (Original / Reignited Trilogy)
characters.summary: Spyro the Dragon fights using fiery breath attacks, horn charges, and agile gliding. He utilizes elemental breaths and aerial mobility to outmaneuver and incinerate enemies.

mechanisms: Sparx the Dragonfly acting as a health buffer against hits

weaknesses: Cannot sustain true powered flight indefinitely without specific power-ups
limitations: Gliding is limited in duration and altitude gain without whirlwinds

sources.supports: Spyro's abilities including flame breath, charging, and gliding.
Combat mechanics and Sparx health system.

feats.claim: Defeated Gnasty Gnorc, Ripto, and the Sorceress.
feats.citation: Spyro the Dragon, Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!, Spyro: Year of the Dragon

notableResults.note: Burned down Gnasty's defenses and defeated him.

campaignTags.claim: Spyro breathes fire to attack enemies and burn obstacles.
Generates and projects streams of fire from his mouth.
Can glide across chasms using wings.

unknowns: Differences in breath powers between classic continuity and The Legend of Spyro trilogy.

characters.summary: Sub-Zero (Bi-Han or Kuai Liang) utilizes cryomancy to freeze opponents, create ice weapons, and control the battlefield. He combines martial arts proficiency with lethal ice manipulation.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to extreme heat or fire-based combatants who can melt his ice constructs
limitations: Ice attacks require stamina and focus; sustained heavy attacks can shatter his constructs

sources.supports: Sub-Zero overview, cryomancy abilities, and Lin Kuei background.
Specific ice techniques, fatalities, and combat history.

feats.claim: Defeated Scorpion, Sektor, and various combatants in Mortal Kombat tournaments.

notableResults.note: Killed by Scorpion in vengeance for the Shirai Ryu clan.

campaignTags.claim: Sub-Zero manipulates ice to freeze opponents.
Generates ambient ice and frost to control the arena.
Creates melee weapons out of solid ice such as swords and axes.

unknowns: Distinctions between Bi-Han and Kuai Liang's power levels in certain reboot timelines.
